F005.note: Core role-registry checks are present, but manifest validation and managed-block freshness are incomplete.

F006.note: Reconcile behavior is mostly sound, but split-brain detection is only wired through doctor --agent, not the normal doctor path.

findings.issue: agent-manifest validation is unsound: agent_manifest.load_manifest() swallows invalid JSON/schema and returns None, so doctor --agent reports an invalid existing manifest as a valid missing zero-state instead of FAILing.

managed-block freshness only compares generator version. It does not validate the stored hash/body against the current generated brief, so edited or content-stale AGENTS.md managed blocks can pass as current.

split-brain home detection is not included in the default dontpanic doctor run_all_checks path; users running the canonical doctor command will not see ~/.dontpanic vs ~/.jarvis contradictions unless they know to run doctor --agent.

managed-block remediation for registered projects suggests `dontpanic projects add NAME PATH --onboard`, but projects add refuses an already-registered project without `--force --yes`, so the printed remediation is not directly executable for the common registered-project case.
